_source: Breakthrough Basketball - Sample drills for import

drills.name: Mikan Drill
drills.description: Classic drill to develop touch around the rim using alternating layups. Named after George Mikan, one of basketball's first dominant big men.
instructions: Stand under the basket on the right side
Shoot a right-handed layup off the backboard
Grab the ball out of the net without letting it hit the ground
Take one step to the left side and shoot a left-handed layup
Continue alternating sides without letting the ball touch the ground
Complete 20-30 makes or set a time limit
keyPoints: Use the backboard on every shot
Keep the ball high - don't bring it below your chin
Use proper footwork (right foot plants for left-hand layup)
variations: Reverse Mikan: Use reverse layups instead
Power Mikan: Add a power dribble before each layup
Extended Mikan: Start from further out, adding a dribble

drills.name: 3-Man Weave
drills.description: Classic basketball drill that develops passing, cutting, communication, and conditioning. Players weave down the court passing and going behind.
instructions: Three players line up across the baseline
Middle player starts with the ball
Pass to either wing player, then run behind that player
Wing catches and passes to the opposite player, runs behind
Continue weaving down the court
Finish with a layup at the opposite basket
Jog back and repeat
keyPoints: Call out teammate's name before passing
Stay wide to stretch the defense
Finish with a proper layup, not a throw
variations: 2-on-1 finish: Defense added at the end

drills.name: Full Court Dribbling Series
drills.description: Progressive ball handling drill that develops both hands and multiple dribble moves while moving up and down the court.
instructions: Right hand only down the court, left hand back
Crossover at each free throw line and half court
Between the legs at each line
Behind the back at each line
Combination moves (your choice) full speed
Repeat each move 2 times
keyPoints: Keep your eyes up - don't watch the ball
Stay low in an athletic stance
Push the ball out in front, don't slap at it
Use your fingertips, not your palm
Protect the ball with your off hand
variations: Add cones as defenders to go around
Tennis ball in off hand - bounce and catch while dribbling

drills.name: Closeout Drill
drills.description: Teaches proper defensive closeout technique - how to approach a shooter and contest without fouling or getting beat off the dribble.
instructions: Defender starts under the basket
Coach/player passes to offensive player on the wing
Defender sprints out with high hands
Chop steps to slow down the last 2-3 feet
Contest the shot or play live 1-on-1
Rotate positions after each rep
keyPoints: Sprint 2/3 of the distance, chop the last 1/3
Hands high to contest the shot
variations: Add shot fake - defender must stay down
Game situation: play to a stop or score

drills.name: Form Shooting Progression
drills.description: Systematic approach to building proper shooting mechanics using the BEEF principles (Balance, Eyes, Elbow, Follow-through).
instructions: Start 3 feet from basket, one hand only
Focus on wrist snap and follow through
Make 5, then add guide hand (no push)
Make 5, move to free throw line
Make 5, move to elbow
Make 5, move to 3-point line
keyPoints: Balance: Feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend
Eyes: Focus on the rim (front or back)
Elbow: Directly under the ball, forms an L
variations: One knee shooting: Focus on alignment

drills.name: Shell Drill
drills.description: The foundation of team defense. Teaches help-side positioning, rotations, and communication in a controlled 4-on-4 setting.
instructions: 4 offensive players around the perimeter
4 defenders in proper position
Offense passes the ball - no dribbling initially
Defense moves on each pass: on-ball, deny, help
Coach calls 'Live' for 4-on-4 play
Defense must get a stop to rotate out
keyPoints: Jump to the ball on every pass
See man and ball at all times

drills.name: Suicide Sprints
drills.description: Classic basketball conditioning drill that builds speed, endurance, and mental toughness. Sprint to each line and back.
instructions: Start on the baseline
Sprint to free throw line and back
Sprint to half court and back
Sprint to far free throw line and back
Sprint to far baseline and back
Touch each line with your hand
keyPoints: Touch every line - no cutting corners
Recover quickly for the next rep
variations: 17s: Sideline to sideline, 17 times in 1 minute

drills.name: Pick and Roll Reads
drills.description: Teaches the ball handler and screener to read the defense and make the correct play in pick and roll situations.
instructions: Ball handler at top, screener at elbow
Two defenders play different coverages
Screener sets screen, ball handler attacks
Read #1: Defender goes under - pull up jumper
Read #2: Defender goes over - turn corner
Read #3: Big hedges - pocket pass to roller
Read #4: Switch - attack mismatch
keyPoints: Set up your defender before using screen
Wait for the screen - don't rush
Screener: Sprint to the rim or pop
variations: Add a third defender for rotation reads
Spain pick and roll (back screen on roller's defender)
Empty corner vs help defender present

drills.name: Dynamic Warm-Up
drills.description: Full-body dynamic stretching routine to prepare players for practice or games. Activates muscles and increases heart rate.
instructions: High knees across the court
Butt kicks back
Karaoke/Carioca both directions
Walking lunges with twist
Frankensteins (straight leg kicks)
Defensive slides
Backpedal and sprint
variations: Partner mirror: One leads, one follows

drills.name: 5 Spot Shooting
drills.description: Game-like shooting drill from 5 spots around the arc. Develops range, consistency, and the ability to shoot from different angles.
instructions: 5 spots: Both corners, both wings, top of key
Shoot 2 shots from each spot
Rotate clockwise after each set
Complete 3 full rotations (30 shots)
Track makes and percentage
Partner rebounds and passes
keyPoints: Catch ready to shoot - feet set
variations: Off the dribble: 1-2 dribbles before shot
Catch and shoot vs shot fake drive
